svg.title: AWS Serverless Data Pipeline Architecture
svg.desc: Event-driven pipeline: S3 upload triggers Lambda, which kicks off Glue ETL, registers schema in Glue Catalog, enables Athena queries, and QuickSight dashboards. EventBridge tracks job state, SNS sends alerts, CloudWatch monitors everything.
svg.text: Fully serverless — no infrastructure to manage
S3 · Lambda · Glue · Athena · QuickSight · EventBridge · SNS · CloudWatch
